rights.scope: Amphora-authored marine epoxy-amine constrained-mixture regions with multicomponent linear constraints (pigment-volume-concentration bands per Asbeck & Van Loo 1949, amine-H:epoxide stoichiometric-ratio bands per Lee & Neville 1967). Nominal audit constants (densities, EEW, AHEW) are Amphora-chosen round handbook-typical values for AUDIT_ONLY geometry oracles; they are not measured supplier data and carry no third-party database rights.

primary_sources.source: Snee, R.D. (1979) Experimental designs for mixture systems with multicomponent constraints, Commun. Stat. Theory Methods A8(4):303-326
Piepel, G.F. (1988) Programs for generating extreme vertices and centroids of linearly constrained experimental regions, J. Qual. Technol. 20(2):125-136
Snee, R.D. & Marquardt, D.W. (1974) Extreme vertices designs for linear mixture models, Technometrics 16(3):399-408

Lee, H. & Neville, K. (1967) Handbook of Epoxy Resins, McGraw-Hill
Cornell, J.A. (2002) Experiments with Mixtures, 3rd ed., Wiley

constants_note: All numeric constants are decimal strings parsed as exact rationals. Densities in g/cm3 of the wet-paint component as dosed; EEW/AHEW in g/eq. PVC is computed on the solvent-free (dry-film) volume basis: PVC = V_pigment / (V_pigment + V_binder), with V_i = x_i / rho_i per unit mixture mass. The stoichiometric index r = (x_amine/AHEW) / (x_epoxy/EEW) is amine-H equivalents per epoxide equivalent.

regions.industrial_context: Marine anti-corrosion two-part epoxy-amine primer, weight fractions of the mixed (A+B) wet paint; cycloaliphatic-amine-class hardener; PVC band plus stoichiometric band.
High-build marine barrier topcoat with glass-flake extender, polyamide-class hardener; PVC band over TiO2+flake, stoichiometric band.
Solvent-free tank-lining epoxy, talc extender; tight stoichiometric band, PVC band.
Primer region with a single multicomponent constraint: tight stoichiometric band, no PVC band.
Primer region with a single multicomponent constraint: tight PVC band, no stoichiometric band.
Solvent-free lining locked at exact 1:1 amine-H:epoxide stoichiometry (degenerate band lower == upper); the feasible set collapses to a lower-dimensional face.
